name: Wool Mania - Sort Puzzle 3D 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Wool Mania – Sort Puzzle 3D is a relaxing and brain-teasing game where you untangle colorful yarn to create beautiful thread patterns. Drag and match wool pieces across 3D boards, connect them to the right pegs, and solve puzzles featuring knots, limited moves, and multi-hole challenges.
